Categories.value: PD US|Merytaten|Tomb of Meryre II|Smenkhkare|N. de Garis Davies|PD-US missing SDC copyright status|The rock tombs of El Amarna (1903)

ImageDescription.value: Line drawing of two figures from the tomb of Meryre II in Amarna.  The inset (from the original) shows Lepsius drawing of the now missing cartouche sets identifying the figures as Ankhkheperure Smenkhkare Djser Kheperu and his wife Meritaten.

Credit.value: The Rock Tombs of Amarna, Part II published 1905
